title: the ...
summary: Когда использовать **the**: понятные из ситуации предметы, **the same**, **the sun / the sky / the world**, **the top / the end / the middle**, музыкальные инструменты, **the radio**; и когда **the** не нужен.
ru:
## Когда ставим the
**the** нужен, если понятно, о каком предмете или человеке речь.
> What's the name of this street? — Как называется эта улица? (у улицы одно название)
> Who is the best player in your team? — Кто лучший игрок в команде?
> Can you tell me the time, please? — Подскажите время, пожалуйста.
> My office is on the first floor. — Мой офис на первом этаже.
Не забывайте **the** там, где он нужен: ~~near city centre~~ → near **the** city centre; ~~where is nearest bank?~~ → where is **the** nearest bank?

## the same — тот же
Всегда **the same**, без пропусков.
> We live in **the same** street. — Мы живём на одной улице.
> 'Are these two books different?' 'No, they're **the same**.' — Эти книги разные? — Нет, одинаковые.
Нельзя: ~~in same street~~.

## the + единственное в мире
**the sun, the moon, the sky, the world, the sea, the country** — они одни.
> The sky is blue and **the sun** is shining. — Небо голубое, светит солнце.
> Do you live in a town or in **the country**? — Вы живёте в городе или за городом?

## the + службы
**the police, the fire brigade, the army** — организации.
> My brother is a soldier. He's in **the army**. — Мой брат солдат. Он служит в армии.

## the + положение
**the top, the bottom, the end, the middle, the left, the right**.
> Write your name at **the top** of the page.
> My house is at **the end** of this street.
> The table is in **the middle** of the room.
> Do you drive on **the right** or on **the left**?

## the + музыкальные инструменты, the radio
> Paula is learning to play **the piano**. — Паула учится играть на пианино.
> I listen to **the radio** a lot. — Я много слушаю радио.

## Без the: television
> I watch **television** a lot. (не ~~the television~~)
> What's on **television** tonight?
Но: *Turn off **the** TV* (имеется в виду конкретный телевизор).

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~in same street~~ → in **the same** street
- ~~I play piano.~~ → I play **the** piano.
- ~~I watch the television.~~ → I watch **television**.
en:
## When we use the
We use **the** when it is clear which thing or person we mean.
> What's the name of this street?
> Who is the best player in your team?
> Can you tell me the time, please?
> My office is on the first floor.
Don't forget **the**: ~~near city centre~~ → near **the** city centre.

## the same
> We live in **the same** street.
> 'Are these two books different?' 'No, they're **the same**.'
We can't say ~~in same street~~.

## One in the world
**the sun, the moon, the sky, the world, the sea, the country**
> The sky is blue and **the sun** is shining.
> Do you live in a town or in **the country**?

## Services
**the police, the fire brigade, the army**
> He's a soldier. He's in **the army**.

## Positions
**the top, the bottom, the end, the middle, the left, the right**
> Write your name at **the top** of the page.
> My house is at **the end** of this street.
> Do you drive on **the right** or on **the left**?

## Instruments and the radio
> Paula is learning to play **the piano**.
> I listen to **the radio** a lot.

## No the: television
> I watch **television** a lot.
But: *Turn off **the** TV.* (a specific TV)

## Common mistakes
- ~~in same street~~ → in **the same** street
- ~~I play piano.~~ → I play **the** piano.
- ~~I watch the television.~~ → I watch **television**.
structure:
## the — со всем, что понятно
> **the** + существительное (ситуация ясна): **the** door, **the** station, **the** first floor

## Постоянные сочетания
| С the | Пример |
|---|---|
| the same | in **the same** class |
| the sun / moon / sky / sea / world | **the sun** is hot |
| the country | in **the country** |
| the police / army / fire brigade | He's in **the army** |
| the top / end / middle / left / right | at **the end** of the street |
| play the + инструмент | play **the piano** / **the guitar** |
| the radio | listen to **the radio** |

## Без the
| Без the | Пример |
|---|---|
| television | I watch **television**. |
| (но с a TV) | There is **a** TV in my room. |
